product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk is an AI-powered business phone and voice-agent platform that combines calling and call intelligence for small and mid-sized sales and support teams.
product_one_liner.notes: CloudTalk describes its product as an AI-powered business phone system and AI voice-agent platform for small and mid-sized sales and support teams.

pricing_page.notes: CloudTalk has a public pricing page that presents flexible plans and plan comparisons, so a public pricing page exists regardless of whether every price is displayed.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: CloudTalk's customer-stories index includes customer-story links naming Pipedrive and Circle Gym. | named_customers.0: CloudTalk's customer-stories page includes a Pipedrive customer story. | named_customers.1: CloudTalk's customer-stories page includes a Circle Gym customer story.

employee_band.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile reports a company-size band of 201–500 employees, matching the allowed band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: CloudTalk's contact page labels its Toronto address as Canada HQ, establishing Toronto as the headquarters city. | hq_country: CloudTalk's contact page explicitly labels its Toronto address as Canada HQ, establishing Canada as the headquarters country.

founded_year.notes: CloudTalk's own company story explicitly says it was founded in 2016.

eng_blog.notes: The developer-blog index shows technical-backlog and integration/AI-tool posts, but the cited bylines identify their authors as Senior Copywriters. The evidence does not establish two technical posts by engineers, which is required for a true value; therefore this is false under the field rule.

public_docs.notes: CloudTalk has public developer documentation and an index linking multiple webhook, API, and MCP guides, meeting the requirement for several documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live CloudTalk posting dated November 6, 2026 is titled Product Education Manager (AI-Enabled). The posting's work is product education and AI-assisted documentation rather than model research, so the title-based criterion creates some ambiguity; it nevertheless explicitly includes AI and is not an AI-sales title.

model_provider.value: OpenAI models (GPT-4o Mini, GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 Mini/Nano, and GPT-5) are supported; the voice-agent documentation also lists ElevenLabs and Deepgram as speech-provider options.
model_provider.notes: CloudTalk's public VoiceAgent documentation lists OpenAI GPT models as supported LLMs and names ElevenLabs and Deepgram as speech-provider options. The documentation establishes available providers/models, not which configuration every customer uses.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: CloudTalk's security page names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001; its trust-center listings name ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS SAQ A 4.0. The answer includes only the requested categories named in these sources. | compliance_certs.0: The security page and trust center name SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: CloudTalk's security and trust sources name ISO 27001, including ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.2: The CloudTalk trust-center badge/listing names HIPAA. | compliance_certs.3: The CloudTalk trust-center listing names GDPR. | compliance_certs.4: The trust center names PCI DSS SAQ A 4.0.

raised_18mo.notes: CloudTalk's identified most recent round was January 2024, before the 18-month window beginning May 2025; the funding profile updated in November 2026 still identifies it as the latest round, so it did not raise in that window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: CloudTalk's current Workable openings include Account Executive roles, so it is hiring for a title covered by the SDR/BDR/AE criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: CloudTalk announced the launch of its AI Sales Dialer on November 9, 2026, within the six months before the specified run date.
